media.title: Attack on Titan
media.description: Humanity lives confined within massive walled cities to protect themselves from giant, mindless humanoids known as Titans. When a colossal Titan breaches the outer defenses, young Eren Jaeger vows to wipe them out completely.

media.title: The Conjuring
media.description: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren travel to a remote Rhode Island farmhouse to assist a terrified family experiencing malicious, terrifying supernatural manifestations.

media.title: Interstellar
media.description: With Earth facing an agricultural collapse, a team of intrepid astronauts and explorers travels through a newly discovered wormhole in deep space to find a habitable new home for human civilization.

media.title: The Matrix
media.description: A disillusioned computer hacker discovers that his entire reality is an elaborate simulation controlled by malevolent cybernetic machines, joining a rebellion to liberate human minds.

media.title: More than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers
media.description: High school students Jirou and Akari are forced into a mandatory school marriage simulation project where they must live together as a couple, despite both having crushes on completely different people.

media.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
media.description: A reprogrammed T-800 cyborg is sent back in time to protect a young John Connor from a highly advanced, shape-shifting liquid metal liquid assassin known as the T-1000.

media.title: The Eminence in Shadow
media.description: Reincarnated into a magical world, Cid acts out his ultimate fantasy of becoming a shadowy mastermind orchestrating events from the background, unaware that the evil cult he invented is actually real.

media.title: Titanic
media.description: A young, aristocratic woman falls deeply in love with a free-spirited, working-class artist aboard the luxurious yet ill-fated maiden voyage of the R.M.S. Titanic.

media.title: Inception
media.description: A skilled corporate thief specializes in stealing valuable secrets from deep within the subconscious minds of targets during their dream states, taking on a final dangerous job to plant an idea instead.

media.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation
media.description: A discouraged 34-year-old underachiever dies and is reborn into a magical fantasy universe as a child named Rudeus Greyrat. Retaining his memories, he resolves to master sorcery and live an honorable life.

media.title: The Dark Knight
media.description: Batman must face his most devastating psychological and physical test yet when a psychopathic mastermind anarchist known as the Joker unleashes absolute chaos and violence across Gotham City.

media.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
media.description: An ordinary office employee is stabbed on the street and reincarnated into a high-fantasy realm as a low-level slime monster named Rimuru Tempest, acquiring immense powers to unite local tribes.

media.title: Spirited Away
media.description: A young girl stumbles into an enchanted spirit world ruled by an ancient witch. After her parents are turned into pigs, she must work diligently in a magical bathhouse to win back their freedom.

media.title: Demon Slayer: Mugen Train
media.description: Tanjiro Kamado and his demon-slaying companions board a mysterious passenger train to assist the powerful Flame Hashira, Kyojuro Rengoku, in eliminating a demon devouring passengers.

media.title: Gladiator
media.description: A betrayed Roman general is reduced to slavery after his family is brutally murdered by a corrupt emperor. He rises through the ranks of the gladiator arenas to exact his final vengeance.

media.title: Jujutsu Kaisen 0
media.description: A troubled high school student haunted by the powerful cursed spirit of his deceased childhood friend joins Tokyo Jujutsu High School to master his dangerous energy and break the curse.
